scope: All exposed TensorRT Inspector fields; verified tensor renames and intentional DCN identity substitution only
compared_fields: Every field in every layer record; every top-level field except Layers list order is also compared

plugin_configuration_evidence.note: Inspector does not expose serialized DCN options; configuration is checked from the structural rewrite audit, not inferred from Inspector.

limitations: Inspector does not expose every execution decision, weight byte, serialized plugin field or generated machine instruction.
Listed layer order is not a proof of device execution order; reordered records are reported, never silently treated as scheduling equivalence.
External plugin libraries intentionally differ. Numerical comparison and runtime library hashes require separate run reports.
This establishes no additional speed or accuracy claim beyond the independent whole-model A/B and output comparisons.
